about.title: Westminster Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Westminster sits in the middle of Orange County, and a lot of its traffic funnels onto a handful of roads: Beach Boulevard (State Route 39), Goldenwest Street and Westminster Boulevard. Public collision records show those corridors carry the highest crash counts in the city. In 2025, the last complete year on file, Westminster recorded 82 injury collisions, 112 people injured and 1 traffic death among roughly 92,000 residents. Reports also cluster on Thursdays in the hours just after midnight. If one of those numbers now includes you, the days ahead can feel scattered. Medical visits, a car in the shop, an adjuster leaving voicemails. We exist to take one item off that list. Tell us what happened, and our team will review your case at no cost. We handle car accident claims on contingency, meaning you pay nothing upfront, and we only collect a fee if your case produces a recovery. From there, we can help you preserve photos, footage and repair records while you concentrate on getting well.

items.title: Two Years Goes Quickly
items.desc: California generally gives you two years to file a car accident lawsuit, and claims involving a city or state vehicle can require notice in as little as six months. Connecting with us early keeps those dates from sneaking up on you.

items.title: Shared Blame Doesn't End Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you were partly responsible, you can still recover damages reduced by your share. We can push back when an insurer tries to inflate your percentage.

items.title: No Fee Without a Recovery
items.desc: We work on contingency, meaning you owe nothing unless your case results in compensation. Our case review is free, and California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in ordinary car crash cases.

items.question: The other driver's insurer wants a recorded statement about my Beach Boulevard crash. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement, and it is usually wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters may use small inconsistencies in your account to shift blame under California's comparative fault rules. Report the crash to your own insurer as your policy requires, but let us handle communication with the other side.

items.question: What evidence should I hold onto after a Westminster car accident?
items.answer: Keep photos of the vehicles, the roadway and your injuries, along with the police report number and contact details for any witnesses. Save medical bills, repair estimates and any texts or emails from insurers. If the crash happened near a business on Goldenwest Street or Westminster Boulevard, nearby cameras may have captured it, and we can request that footage before it is overwritten.

items.question: Do you charge for reviewing my case?
items.answer: No. We provide free case reviews. We handle car accident cases on contingency, so you pay no attorney fee unless there is a recovery in your case.
